title: Profile
description: What backend/profiler reads from a portfolio: the stack and concepts the domain task is built from, and the DSA topics each tier may use. Computed by deterministic rules; an LLM fills a field only when the rules find nothing (see `sources`).

concepts.description: Concepts from the seed concept vocabulary (union of seeds/*/concepts.yaml), strongest evidence first.

topics_solved.description: Problems solved per canonical DSA topic (dsa/taxonomy.yaml), after mapping the portfolio's topic names through their synonyms and summing.

allowed_topics.description: Canonical DSA topics allowed for each tier: listed for the tier in the taxonomy and solved at least the tier difficulty's threshold times.

tier_reason.description: Why this tier, in one sentence with the numbers used.

unsupported_notes.description: What the profiler could not use as claimed: unsupported stacks and the runtime used instead, unknown DSA topic names, failed fallbacks.

sources.description: Where each inferred field came from. rules: keyword rules. llm: the generator fallback (rules found nothing). default: neither found anything.
